name: Solar Power Vermont
old_description: At Solar Power VT, we specialize in providing comprehensive solar energy solutions for residential and commercial clients, with a primary focus on residential projects. Our services encompass every aspect of solar power, from sales and design to installation and maintenance of solar panels and battery backup systems. Our expert team is dedicated to helping you harness the power of the sun to reduce your energy costs and carbon footprint. Whether you're looking to install a new solar system or maintain an existing one, Solar Power VT is your trusted partner for reliable, sustainable energy solutions.
about:
Solar Power Vermont operates from West Burke in Vermont's Northeast Kingdom. The company was founded by Zeb Smith, a native of the region who built carpentry skills working with his father before earning a business degree from BYU. After three years as lead installer and four years total at Solar Tech VT, plus experience in solar mounting manufacturing, Smith launched his own venture to provide full-service solar solutions.

The firm delivers turnkey photovoltaic systems for homes and businesses, handling design, permitting, installation, and ongoing maintenance. Core offerings include grid-tied arrays with net metering, battery backup installations for whole-home or critical-load support, and repair services for existing systems. Projects begin with a detailed site evaluation that measures roof orientation, pitch, and shading, then proceeds to either roof-mounted or ground-mounted arrays with concealed conduit runs.

Customers range from residential owners in towns like Greensboro to commercial operations such as Butternut Mountain Farm, whose president praised the battery backup design. The company also assists clients with financing through VSECU's Energy Improvement loan program. Most work is concentrated in northern Vermont, though the service area extends across the state.

Smith's hands-on background in mounting hardware informs the company's emphasis on structural integrity and aesthetic conduit routing. The business differentiates itself by keeping the owner directly involved in every project, from initial consultation to final commissioning, and by offering a single point of contact for both installation and long-term service.

name: Solar Pro
old_description: Backed by expert installation and ongoing support, our solar solutions are designed to power your home or business efficiently and sustainably reduce energy costs while increasing long-term reliability.
about:
Solar Pro operates from Rapid City, South Dakota, serving the Black Hills region. The company was formed when two established local contractors, Wires‑R‑Us and Hunter Homes, each with more than 20 years of experience in the area, teamed up to create a dedicated solar installation group. Their combined background in customer service and construction laid the foundation for a business focused on personalized, community‑oriented energy solutions.

The firm delivers end‑to‑end solar services for residential and commercial clients, including custom system design, installation, monitoring, and ongoing maintenance. They handle both grid‑interactive and off‑grid configurations, integrating high‑efficiency monocrystalline panels, hybrid inverters, and LiFePO4 battery storage. Projects range from rooftop arrays on homes to ground‑mount systems for commercial shops, with support for permitting, financial analysis, and tax‑incentive optimization.

Solar Pro’s customer base spans homeowners, landlords, builders, and businesses across western South Dakota. Examples include a rental‑property owner who reported increased property value, a home builder (Hunter Homes) that now includes Solar Pro systems in all new construction, and an off‑grid commercial shop in Piedmont. The company also works with businesses seeking to reduce operating costs through peak‑shaving and time‑of‑use strategies.

The founders emphasize a hands‑on, local approach: every installation is backed by direct after‑sales support from the installing team, real‑time monitoring via a mobile app, and a commitment to using only top‑tier components. They cite their decades of combined experience and a focus on personalized design as the reasons clients trust them for long‑term reliability.

name: Solar Scapes
old_description: Your solar system works every day to lower your energy costs, but even the best systems develop issues over time. Solar Shield removes the guesswork with scheduled maintenance, professional inspections, ongoing monitoring, and priority support from a local company that specializes in long-term solar care.
about:
Solar Scapes operates from Grain Valley, Missouri, serving the greater Kansas City metropolitan area. The company was founded by Cory B., who serves as owner and field operator, on the conviction that solar customers deserve ongoing support long after installation. The business began with specialized solar care and maintenance before expanding into a full-service energy partner.

Today Solar Scapes designs and installs solar arrays, provides service and troubleshooting for systems from any manufacturer, and offers the Solar Shield maintenance membership with tiered annual plans that include cleaning, inspections, active monitoring, and thermal imaging. The team also installs FranklinWH and Enphase battery storage, Generac standby generators, and EV charging equipment, and performs solar removal and reinstallation for roof replacements. A crew of three field technicians handles projects across both sides of the state line.

The company serves residential and commercial customers throughout the Kansas City metro, including Overland Park, Olathe, Lenexa, Shawnee, Leawood, Lee’s Summit, Independence, Blue Springs, and Liberty. Clients range from homeowners with orphaned systems whose original installer has disappeared to businesses seeking backup power and electrical upgrades.

Solar Scapes differentiates itself by focusing on long-term system health rather than one-time sales. Its NABCEP-certified technicians service orphaned systems, and the company holds certified installer status for FranklinWH, Enphase, and Generac equipment. The Solar Shield program adds scheduled maintenance, priority scheduling, and detailed reporting to protect production over the system’s 25-year design life.

name: Solora Solar
old_description: I had been trying for months to get the company that installed my system to correct a problem with one of my inverters that kept shutting down. After getting the run around and being told the problem was in the wiring in my house I called Solora Solar. They stopped by and not only diagnosed the problem was in one of the inverters but called the manufacturer of the inverter and got them to send me a replacement ( it was under warranty }. They did in 20 minutes what I couldn't the other guys to do all summer. They truly earned 5 stars with us.
about:
Solora Solar, based in Yakima, Washington, has been designing and installing solar energy systems since 2005. The company operates as a turnkey installer serving residential, commercial, public-sector, and agricultural customers across the state.

The firm provides full engineering, procurement, and construction (EPC) services for solar projects, including site evaluation, system design, permitting, utility interconnection, and commissioning. It also installs battery storage systems from brands such as LG Prime, Enphase, Tesla, and Generac, and assists clients with federal REAP grant applications and community solar programs.

Solora’s customer base includes homeowners in communities like Selah, Bellevue, and Yakima; commercial operators with installations up to 200 kW; farms and rural businesses leveraging USDA funding; and nonprofit organizations accessing community solar. The company manages all paperwork, from tax incentive forms to warranty registration, and provides 24/7 lifetime support after commissioning.

Founded on a “powering one roof at a time” philosophy, Solora differentiates itself with a structured five-step process, conservative production modeling that lists every equipment make and model, and a commitment to handling every administrative detail so clients never have to lift a finger.

name: Somic America
old_description: A leading supplier to the automotive manufacturing market, Somic America specializes in the engineering, design, and manufacturing of quality ball joints for suspension and steering systems, and rotary dampers for seat and tailgate applications.
about:
Somic America operates from Wytheville, Virginia, with an additional facility in Brewer, Maine. The company has served the North and South American automotive markets for more than 35 years as a subsidiary of Somic Ishikawa, a Japanese component manufacturer founded in 1916 that became a Toyota partner in 1937. Somic Ishikawa established the U.S. operation to provide local sourcing and direct access to its global engineering and manufacturing capabilities.

The company engineers, designs, and manufactures ball joints for suspension and steering systems, rotary dampers for seat and tailgate applications, and various steering gear and control arm components. Its vertically integrated processes encompass machining, assembly, and rapid design changes, producing over one million components each week across its two U.S. sites. Robotic scanning and 100% inspection validate every part before shipment.

Somic America supplies vehicle manufacturers throughout the Americas, focusing on safety-critical steering and suspension components. Its customer base includes OEMs that require IATF 16949-certified quality systems and zero-defect targets. The parent company's global footprint spans eight countries, reinforcing technical support for North and South American programs.

The company emphasizes a culture of continuous improvement, or Kaizen, with 90 percent of improvement initiatives originating from machine operators. Standardized work across engineering, machining, and quality teams, combined with a pledge to 100% on-time delivery, underpins its reputation for reliability in safety-critical automotive applications.

name: Sonrise Apparel Services LLC
old_description: Sonrise Apparel Services is a vertical contract cutting and sewing company. We offer services ranging from product development to sewing and finishing. We serve soft goods manufacturing companies who have a product and need to get it made and to their customers in a timely manner. The Sonrise ideal customer is an established company with consistent and or large volume production.  However, Sonrise also has the capabilities to work with smaller companies with medium volume production.
about:
Sonrise Apparel Services operates from Dallas, Texas, where Nicole Beavers founded the company in 2005. A Women’s Business Enterprise (WBE) certified, woman-owned business, it began after Beavers experienced repeated frustration with inefficient, dishonest cutting and sewing contractors while managing production for apparel brands. She launched Sonrise to provide a vertically integrated, communication-first alternative.

The company functions as a vertical contract cutting and sewing shop, handling product development, bulk cutting, die cutting on a hydraulic die press, hot strip cutting, sewing, marker and pattern plotting, assembly, packaging, pick-and-pack, and warehousing. It advertises medium to large contract capabilities with typical turnaround times of four to six weeks. A small production team includes Production Manager Rosalva “Rosie” Almaraz, who has been with the firm since 2008.

Sonrise serves soft‑goods manufacturers across apparel, dancewear, and promotional product segments. Established brands such as Crazy Pants, CC Dancewear, and Good Air Team are cited as customers, alongside start‑up companies needing initial production runs and larger businesses seeking to expand output.

Beavers has stated that the company was created to counter the industry’s norm of missed deadlines and poor communication. Sonrise emphasizes an open, fair, team‑focused approach, prioritizing honesty, hard work, and consistent quality over pure volume quotas.

Source Engineering emphasizes three differentiators: cutting-edge technology and advanced machinery for precision and consistency; an experienced staff with years of custom cable assembly expertise; and strict quality control measures throughout the manufacturing process.

name: South Bay Circuits, Inc.
old_description: South Bay Circuits, Inc. is a printed circuit board manufacturer in Chandler, Arizona, offering circuit fabrication, assembly, backplane assembly, card cage services, and testing.
about:
South Bay Circuits, Inc. was founded in 1981 in Chandler, Arizona. The company began as a printed circuit board manufacturer and has grown into a single-source provider of electronic manufacturing services.

The company operates a 60,000-square-foot facility where it provides PCB design and layout, fabrication through manufacturing partners, circuit card assembly (CCA), backplane assembly, box build, and a range of testing services including automated optical inspection, X-ray verification, in-circuit and functional testing. It supports prototype through production volumes, offering turnaround times as short as 24 hours for layout and same-day assembly for urgent orders.

South Bay Circuits serves customers in medical, industrial, power conversion, instrumentation, automotive, semiconductor, telecommunications, computer storage, contract manufacturing, aerospace and defense, and consumer electronics sectors. Its client base includes original equipment manufacturers and contract manufacturers seeking domestic and offshore production options.

The company emphasizes its "Single Source Solutions" model, aiming to reduce new-product-introduction time and manage cost through integrated design, fabrication, assembly, and test under one roof. It highlights its USA-based manufacturing as a way to avoid overseas delays and tariffs, and it maintains ITAR registration and CMMC Level 1 compliance for defense work.

about:
South Park Metalworks operates from Alpine, Wyoming. The company is led by partners Dillon Denny and Steven Poole, supported by a team that includes lead architectural fabricator Julien Condrey, welding fabricators Stetson Hutmacher and Jensen Ramos Corchado, draftsman Ian Haney, and fabricator Gunner Adams. No founding year or ownership details are disclosed.

The shop provides custom fabrication and installation services for residential and commercial projects, producing guard rails, stairs, platforms, grab rails, verandas, and deck railings. It also handles automotive fabrication for both vintage and modern vehicles, with a noted specialization in aluminum welding. The workforce combines drafting, welding, and fabrication capabilities to take projects from concept through installation.

Customers span homeowners, commercial builders, and automotive enthusiasts. Examples include custom staircases and railings for private residences, structural platforms and guard rails for commercial buildings, and restoration or modification work on classic and modern trucks.

The company emphasizes attention to detail as its defining differentiator, stating that the difference between good and great lies in that focus. Aluminum welding expertise is also highlighted as a core specialty.

name: SouthEastern Solar, Inc
old_description: SouthEastern Solar was founded with the mission to provide clients with quality reliable solar equipment at value prices.  By providing user-friendly engineering design, supplemented with professional installation service, we are able to do that.
about:
SouthEastern Solar, Inc is based in Alabaster, Alabama. The company was founded with the mission to provide clients with quality reliable solar equipment at value prices, combining user-friendly engineering design with professional installation service.

The firm designs and installs photovoltaic systems for residential, commercial, and off-grid applications, including roof-mounted, ground-mounted, and solar farm configurations. It offers 24/7 emergency service and provides a proprietary solar estimator tool to help customers size their systems. Financing options are available through banks, mortgage companies, power purchase agreements, and manufacturers.

SouthEastern Solar serves customers across Alabama counties such as Bibb, Blount, Jefferson, Shelby, St. Clair, Tuscaloosa, and Walker for residential and off-grid projects, while its commercial and industrial work extends to the Florida Panhandle, Georgia, Mississippi, and Tennessee. Client verticals include agriculture, education, healthcare, office, public sector, logistics, religious and non-profit organizations, retail, and leisure.

The company emphasizes affordable, reliable, and efficient systems powered by free sunlight, and it offers free solar site evaluations to prospective customers.
